source: SEC EDGAR 10-K / 10-Q primary documents (as filed) + data.sec.gov submissions JSON + EDGAR index-headers
license: US public records; no reuse restriction; 10 req/s + declared User-Agent

field_map.is_amendment: true for /A forms (archived, excluded from comparison by default)
field_map.accepted_at: SIGNAL TIMESTAMP, UTC ISO 'Z' — from index-headers ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME (US Eastern -> UTC)
field_map.accepted_at_source: index_headers | submissions_json_unverified (fallback, never earlier than truth)
field_map.acceptance_datetime_raw: submissions JSON acceptanceDateTime verbatim (inconsistently NOT UTC — ~37% read UTC+ET offset; see sec_filings_text.py docstring)
field_map.sections.<risk_factors|legal_proceedings: found, text, char_count, start_heading, end_heading, end_found, candidates, toc_duplicate_defeated, short, title_mismatch_fallback (10-K only), flags{no_material_changes, not_applicable, incorporated_by_reference}
field_map.extraction: version (EXTRACTION_VERSION), flags[], counts{} (boilerplate rules applied, tables dropped/kept)

confidence_model: raw bytes: as-filed regulatory records (high; never altered in-archive). sections: heuristic extraction (Item-heading location + ToC defeat) — per-section found/short/end_found flags carry its confidence; cross-reference-index filers flagged, not guessed
cadence: on-demand backfill (sample CLI); write-once raw, sections rewritten only on EXTRACTION_VERSION change
_note: Lazy Prices (Cohen-Malloy-Nguyen 2020) pipeline PR 1: DATA gate only. No similarity scores (PR 2), no prices. Raw primary documents are never deleted.
